# Text as Data: tidytext (todo) {#sec-textasdata}


::: {.callout-note}
**Proposed chapter scope:** Rule- and dictionary-based text analysis with `tidytext`. Covers tokenization, word frequencies, TF-IDF, and dictionary-based sentiment analysis. Deliberately stays at the interpretable/rule-based level.

Topic models (LDA) appear as a *negative example*: bag-of-words topics are lists of words you have to interpret yourself. The modern alternative (embed, cluster, label with an LLM) is in @sec-embeddings.

The chapter ends with document-term counts that are ready to use as features; @sec-ml uses them for a logistic regression.

Include a short callout for readers with their own folder of texts or PDFs, pointing to @sec-readtext.
:::
